description: This PHP class defines the EmailNotification entity used within the OrangeHRM system. It models an email notification with properties including id, name, enabled state, and associated email subscribers, along with relevant ORM mappings for database persistence.

classes.name: EmailNotification
classes.description: Represents an email notification type within the system, including properties for ID, name, enabled status, and associated email subscribers, mapped to the 'ohrm_email_notification' database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this email notification.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this email notification.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the email notification.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the email notification.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the email notification is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the email notification.

methods.name: getEmailSubscribers
methods.description: Returns the list of email subscribers associated with this notification.
